qa_pair.question: Locate the time-jump report caused by changing the Web time zone and corroborate it with the time-management handbook. Write the three recovery stages in their documented order, using lowercase rtc/ntp and the arrow character →.

When a BMC briefly shows the Unix epoch after restart, identify the handbook check that reports both whether network time is enabled and whether synchronization succeeded. Return the complete command only.

After proving that a configured network time server address is valid, the troubleshooting handbook says to verify that the address was written to one trusted-data configuration file. Return its absolute path only.
In the time-management handbook section whose example is ipmitool sel time set "06/13/2025 08:35:00", what exact strftime-style input format is required? Return the format string only.
Follow the no-NTP RTC diagnosis path from the time-management handbook to its CpuBoard MDB BlockIO Read example. What decimal address is passed between the context argument 0 and the read length 8?
Find the OpenUBMC2509 KVM custom-shortcut report where Alt+F2 was intended to switch pages. Which function key was the KVM page already bound to by default? Return the key name only.

In the forum case where a V2-to-V3 upgrade was followed by SSL certificate failure and repeated restarts, which major version did the affected boards automatically return to? Return the version label only.

Find the DC-cycle case where the storage component sometimes missed a power-state transition, then cross-check the related property-subscription discussion. Which org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties signal member triggers the monitor? Preserve its capitalization.
In the LPe32002 FC-card alarm conflict, one implementation was in vpd and the other also synchronized PCIe information. Return the other component's repository-style name only.
In the E810 optical-module temperature investigation, inspect the OpticalTemp Lua request definition. What exact value is assigned to its protocol field? Return the value without quotes.
